_doc: InSync Analytics library-wide identity and masthead constants. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Every skill's renderer reads this file and falls back to its own built-in copy only if this file is missing. Change a value HERE, not in a renderer. The masthead block is enforced at build time by a masthead geometry check (in this skill, references/check_masthead.py); a renderer that hardcodes a different value will fail its self-check.

masthead._doc: Geometry of the three-cell masthead: [logo] [InSync Analytics / Company (TICKER) - Period] [Product name / dates]. Sizes are OOXML half-points; the mark is CSS/Word pixels. These four values are asserted on the rendered PDF, not just in source.
masthead._brand_note: 16.5pt. FIXED for every ticker and every product. Never derive it from the company-line size and never let a long company name shrink it.
masthead._mark_note: Constant in every product. The mark SPANS the two-line text block: its top edge meets the top of 'InSync Analytics' and its bottom edge meets the bottom of the company/ticker line.
masthead._ladder_note: 14pt down to a 10pt floor. Start at the top and step down to the FIRST size whose measured width fits the middle cell. SHRINK, NEVER TRUNCATE: elision is a floor guard only and no real issuer name should reach it. Measure with a per-glyph width table, not a character-count estimate.
masthead._alignment_note: Max allowed |logo_top - brand_top| and |logo_bottom - company_bottom| on the rendered PDF. The per-renderer offsets that achieve this (Word spaceBefore/spaceAfter twips, CSS px) are NOT shared: raw OOXML, the docx npm library and weasyprint each carry different line metrics, so each skill tunes its own offset to hit this shared target.
masthead._period_note: Render '2Q26', never '2Q FY2026'. Normalise in the renderer so an upstream long form still prints short.
masthead._logo_note: Canonical filename and the transparent PNG mark. A skill that ships insync-logo-mark.png or insync-logo.jpg carries the same bytes under a non-standard name.
masthead._suffix_note: One ordinary space before the bracket. The suffix is the identifying half of the line and is NEVER shortened by the ladder or the elision guard.
masthead._exempt_note: The Forecast Reliability Suite renders a dark HTML portal header with an uppercase letterspaced wordmark. It is a deliberately different design language and is NOT held to the Georgia masthead geometry above.

charts._doc: Chart-engine tokens (static-charts skill). Split out because charts need axis, grid and a categorical series ramp that documents have no use for. The tokens that OVERLAP with documents - ink, orange, beat/miss, greys, fonts - are NOT repeated here: the engine reads them from colors/fonts above so a chart's beat green is the same green as a table's Beat cell.
charts._total_note: Deep navy for waterfall subtotal/total bars and the first categorical series. 11.48:1 on white.
charts._series_note: Ordered so adjacent entries separate in colour AND step monotonically in greyscale luminance, so the ramp survives a black-and-white print.
charts._estimate_note: Forecast periods are hatched AND banded, never drawn like reported data.
